title: The Star Quality of New Zealand's Great Barrier Island ｜ 新西兰大屏障岛的星空魅力

sents.en: I was glad I had such terrible jetlag.
sents.cn: 我很庆幸自己时差反应这么严重。

sents.en: Wide awake at 3:30 am with our nine-year-old daughter on our lodge balcony, I stared for hours at the most incredible night sky I've ever seen before the dawn slowly started to rub out the stars on the horizon and the multiple shooting stars faded away.
sents.cn: 凌晨3:30，我和九岁的女儿在旅舍的阳台上完全清醒，一连数小时凝视着我见过的最令人惊叹的夜空，直到黎明缓缓开始抹去地平线上的星星，一道道流星也渐渐消失。

sents.en: We were going to my wife's big family reunion in Auckland, New Zealand, but when we found out that Great Barrier Island, just off the coast, had been recently awarded Dark Sky Sanctuary status·a typically remote area that has an "exceptional or distinguished quality of starry nights"·we thought it would be the perfect place to relax before our busy schedule.
sents.cn: 我们原本是要去新西兰奥克兰参加我妻子的大家庭聚会，但当我们得知近海的大屏障岛最近被授予"暗夜保护区"称号——一个"星空之夜格外卓越出众"的典型偏远地区——时，我们认为它正是我们在繁忙行程前放松身心的理想之地。

sents.en: It's the first island and only the fourth location in the world to achieve this status.
sents.cn: 它是全球首个获此称号的岛屿，也是世界上第四个获此地位的地方。

sents.en: After a 28-hour flight with two travel-sick children, our hearts sank when we saw the tiny twin engine 10-seater that was to take us the 90 km across the Hauraki Gulf to Great Barrier Island.
sents.cn: 在带着两个晕机的孩子飞了28小时后，当我们看到那架将载我们飞越豪拉基湾、前往大屏障岛的10座小型双引擎飞机时，心里一沉。但我们大可不必担心。

sents.en: But we needn't have worried. Whether it was the gravity force of the plane climbing or the noise of the engine, it put our three-year-old daughter instantly to sleep until we bumped down on the grass at Claris Airport. Our first empty sick bag against all the odds... Things were looking up.
sents.cn: 不知是因为飞机爬升时的重力，还是引擎的轰鸣声，它让我们三岁的女儿立刻睡着，直到我们在克拉里斯机场的草地上颠簸着陆。出乎意料地，我们的第一个呕吐袋是空的……情况开始好转。

sents.en: Great Barrier Island has no public facilities and the 950 people living there (though only about half permanently) rely on solar and wind energy, and bottled gas for cooking.
sents.cn: 大屏障岛没有公共设施，岛上950名居民（尽管只有约一半常年居住）依靠太阳能和风能，以及瓶装燃气做饭。这里没有路灯，没有自动取款机或银行。

sents.en: There are no streetlights. There are no cash machines or banks.
sents.cn: 警力由一对夫妇组成，邮递员也只有一人。

sents.en: The police force comprises a husband and wife, and there's one postman. It's not just the lack of light but the lack of noise that's so delightful on this unique and gorgeous scene.
sents.cn: 在这片独特而秀美的景色中，令人愉悦的不仅是光线的缺失，还有噪音的缺失。

sents.en: It was first discovered by East Polynesians about 700 years ago and the Maori name for the island is Aotea.
sents.cn: 约700年前东波利尼西亚人最先发现了它，该岛的毛利语名称是Aotea。

sents.en: Captain Cook gave the island its European name, because it acts as a barrier between the Pacific and the Hauraki Gulf.
sents.cn: 库克船长赋予了它欧洲名字，因为它充当了太平洋与豪拉基湾之间的屏障。

sents.en: The climate here is subtropical (亚热带的) like Auckland's.
sents.cn: 这里的气候和奥克兰一样属于亚热带。

sents.en: The island boasts a beautiful wilderness with dense forests, glorious, unspoilt sandy beaches and plenty of bays and a few mountainous areas where there are good walking tracks among the wetlands and valleys.
sents.cn: 岛上拥有美丽的荒野，有茂密的森林、壮丽而未受破坏的沙滩，还有众多海湾和几处山区，湿地和山谷间有不错的步行小径。

sents.en: You can birdwatch, dive, surf and boat.
sents.cn: 你可以观鸟、潜水、冲浪和泛舟。

sents.en: The best beaches are on the eastern side of the island where the surf is better, too.
sents.cn: 最好的海滩在岛的东侧，那里的海浪也更适宜冲浪。

sents.en: The sheltered western side is where you'll find the best diving and boating.
sents.cn: 避风的西岸则是潜水和泛舟的最佳去处。

sents.en: Lots of people come here for the fantastic fishing spots around the island.
sents.cn: 许多人来这里是为了岛周围绝佳的钓鱼点。

sents.en: Like a lot of spots in New Zealand, there are whale-watching trips and you might just catch sight of sharks.
sents.cn: 和新西兰许多地方一样，这里有观鲸之旅，你或许还能瞥见鲨鱼。

sents.en: It's rare to find an island that really does feel undiscovered·but this is it.
sents.cn: 很难找到一个真正让人觉得未被发现的小岛——但这里就是。

sents.en: When one of my wife's relations, who comes here regularly, found out that we'd been there, he whispered to us, only half-joking: "Shh·don't tell anyone!" The locals are a relaxed and friendly bunch·a lot of them told us that it's like what Waiheke Island (now in effect a suburb of Auckland) was in the 1970s when it was a commune of artists and people wanting to escape the city.
sents.cn: 当我妻子一位常来这里的亲戚得知我们来过，他半开玩笑地低声对我们说："嘘——别告诉任何人！"当地人是放松而友善的一群人——他们中许多人告诉我们，这里就像20世纪70年代怀赫科岛（如今实际上是奥克兰的郊区）的样子，当时那里是艺术家和想要逃离城市的人的聚居地。

sents.en: Our guide for some of our stay was the inestimable Hilde Hoven, a Dark Sky ambassador who runs Good Heavens with Deborah Kilgallon and Orla Cumisky.
sents.cn: 我们逗留期间，部分行程的导游是难得的希尔达∙霍文，一位暗夜大使，她与黛博拉∙基尔加伦、奥拉∙卡米斯基共同经营"好天"（GoodHeavens）。她们带着多布森望远镜和靠枕（仰头惊奇地瞪着看、没有颈部支撑可是件苦差事）来到岛上你所在的任何地方，而且——我们大女儿高兴地听说——还带上热巧克力。

sents.en: They bring their Dobsonian telescope and beanbags (it's hard work staring up wide-eyed in wonder without neck support) and, our elder daughter was glad to hear, hot chocolate to wherever you are on the island.
sents.cn: "说来奇怪，在做光线读数时，"希尔达解释该岛如何获得这一特殊地位时说，"他们发现北侧来自约3000公里外斐济的光污染，比南面奥克兰的还要多。

sents.en: "It's odd but when the light readings were done," said Hilde, explaining how the island was awarded its special status, "they found there was more light pollution on the northern side coming from Fiji, which is about 3,000 km away, than Auckland to the south. It's pretty dark!"
sents.cn: 这里相当黑暗！"

sents.en: Beginning their astronomical PowerPoint demonstration using a green laser pointer, Hilde and Orla showed us the Messier 4 spherical cluster (星团) with white dwarf stars ( 白矮星), Saturn and its rings, the Southern Cross and the Milky Way, which stretched across the sky.
sents.cn: 希尔达和奥拉用绿色激光笔开始他们的天文演示，向我们展示了梅西耶4球状星团（星团）、白矮星（白矮星）、土星及其光环、南十字座和横贯天空的银河。

sents.en: Our daughter was especially taken with Hilde's narrating of the Maori myth of Maui's fish hook to explain the shape of Scorpius.
sents.cn: 我们的女儿尤其被希尔达讲述的毛利神话"毛伊的鱼钩"所吸引，那是用来解释天蝎座形状的。

sents.en: In the fable, Maui hauled the North Island of New Zealand from the bottom of the ocean with his hook.
sents.cn: 在寓言中，毛伊用他的鱼钩将新西兰北岛从海底拖出。

sents.en: We stayed at Mount St Paul's Estate, a luxurious lodge run by the friendly Chris and Teara, both from Canada.
sents.cn: 我们入住的是圣保罗山庄园，一家由来自加拿大的友好夫妇克里斯和蒂拉经营的豪华旅舍。

sents.en: Teara used to be a chef at the Langham in Auckland and so dinner, eaten around a huge circular table (made of one of the most ancient trees in the world), was every bit as mouth-watering as you'd expect.
sents.cn: 蒂拉曾在奥克兰朗廷酒店担任主厨，因此围绕一张巨大的圆桌（由世界上最古老的树木之一制成）享用的晚餐，正如你所期待的那般令人垂涎。

sents.en: Eating pancakes on the balcony overlooking the unspoilt white sandy beach was a great way to start the day.
sents.cn: 在阳台上一边吃薄煎饼、一边俯瞰未受破坏的白色沙滩，是开启一天的好方式。

sents.en: Another highlight was an hour-long walk to Kaitoke hot pools in the centre of the island, through wetlands and a forest, where we whiled away a good hour sitting in the pools shaded from the heat by layers of delicate umbrella-like plants.
sents.cn: 另一处亮点是步行一小时前往岛中心凯托克温泉，穿过湿地和森林，我们在层层精致如伞的植物遮荫下泡在池中，惬意地消磨了大半个小时。K)Wealsolovedvisitingthepotter(陶艺家)SarahHarrison,whoshowedusroundherstudioatShoalBayharbour,andhermanypotsandjugs,platesandbowlsandcolourfulmosaics(马赛克).Inherwork,shealsousesalotofmaterialsfoundonthebeach.OurelderdaughterlovedthegorgeoushiddenpoolatMedlandsbeachwherethewaterisseparatedfromtheseainaprivaterockpool.OtherhighpointsweretheancientpohutukawatreesandtheincredibleviewsofOkiwiBasinandWhangapouabeachfromthetopofWindyCanyon,justa10-minutehikethroughanarrowvalleyupsomesteepwoodenstepsontheeasternsideoftheisland.K）我们也很喜欢拜访陶艺家莎拉∙哈里森，她带我们参观了她在肖尔湾港的工作室，以及她的许多罐子、水壶、盘子和碗，还有色彩斑斓的马赛克（马赛克）。她的作品中也大量使用在沙滩上找到的材料。我们的大女儿喜爱梅德兰兹海滩那处绝佳的隐蔽水潭，那里的水在一个私人的岩石池中与大洋隔开。其他高潮点包括古老的波胡图卡瓦树，以及从风峡谷顶端俯瞰奥基维盆地和万达波阿海滩的绝美景色——只需穿过狭窄山谷、爬上几级陡峭木梯，步行约10分钟即可到达岛东侧。L)ApparentlytheislandcouncilturneddownfamousmusicianPaulMcCartney'sapplicationtobuyapropertyatGreatBarrierIslandbecauseoftheunwelcomeattentionhewouldhavebrought.Youcanseewhyhewantedtocomehere;equally,theislandknowsexactlywhatkindofstarwatchingitprefers.L）显然，岛议会曾拒绝了著名音乐家保罗∙麦卡特尼在大屏障岛购置房产的申请，因为他会带来不受欢迎的关注。你可以理解他为何想来这里；同样，这座岛也清楚自己更偏爱何种"观星"。36.Theauthor'sdaughtersleptthroughoutthelastlegoftheirflighttoGreatBarrierIsland.36.作者的女儿在他们飞往大屏障岛航程的最后一程全程睡着。37.Thelodgewheretheauthorstayedprovidedverydeliciousfood.37.作者入住的旅舍提供了非常美味的食物。38.ManypeopleareattractedtoGreatBarrierIslandbecauseoftheincrediblefishingsitesaroundit.38.许多人被大屏障岛吸引，是因为岛周围令人难以置信的钓鱼点。39.Awell-knownartistfailedtopurchaseahouseonGreatBarrierIsland.39.一位著名艺术家未能在大屏障岛买到一处房子。40.Unabletofallasleepafteralongflight,theauthorwaspleasedtoenjoythemostgorgeousviewofthenightskyinhislife.40.长途飞行后无法入睡，作者欣然欣赏到了他一生中最绚丽的夜空景象。41.GreatBarrierIslandiscomparedtoanotherislandwhichattractedalotofartistsandpeoplewhowishedtostayawayfromcitylifehalfacenturyago.41.大屏障岛被比作另一个岛屿，那个岛在半个世纪前吸引了众多艺术家和想要远离城市生活的人。42.Onemostmemorablepartoftheauthor'svisittoGreatBarrierIslandwasaone-hourwalktoitscentre'shotsprings.42.作者大屏障岛之行的难忘之处之一，是步行一小时前往岛中心温泉的路程。43.GreatBarrierIsla
